Develop strategies to handle asynchronous race conditions and delays. Advanced API Integrity: Manage deep API testing for external integrations. Validate authentication handling (OAuth/Tokens), schema compliance, and implement data integrity checks (hashing) to ensure zero data loss during transit. 2. AI-Augmented Daily Workflows (25%)AI-Driven Productivity: Utilize LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and AI agents to generate test cases, write boilerplate code, and synthesize realistic test data (e.g., synthetic customer records). Exploratory Testing: Conduct AI-guided manual exploratory testing on our websites. Use AI agents to generate "Test Charters" based on changelogs to focus your manual efforts on high-risk areas. 3. Hybrid Business Analysis & Documentation (15%)Shift-Left Analysis: Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements. Use your QA mindset to interrogate business needs, identifying ambiguity and edge cases before development begins. Living Documentation: Champion a "Docs-as-Code" culture. Ensure that documentation for workflows and integrations is kept up-to-date automatically using AI tools and rigorous naming conventions. You define the "Single Source of Truth". 4. Tooling & Infrastructure (10%)Maintain the CI/CD pipeline for n8n workflows (exporting workflows as JSON, validating via CLI). Manage test environments and data mocking strategies for API endpoints and HubSpot. Xem toàn bộ Mô Tả Công Việc Yêu Cầu Công Việc Integration Fluency: 3+ years testing complex integrations involving REST/GraphQL APIs. You can show us how you prompt an LLM to generate a comprehensive test suite or analyze a log file.HubSpot & n8n Expertise: Deep understanding of workflow mechanics, CRM properties, and low-code orchestration logic.API Protocol Mastery: Familiarity with complex authentication flows, rate limiting, and strict data schemas.Hybrid Agility: Comfortable switching between a "Technical Tester" hat (debugging API headers) and a "Business Analyst" hat (defining user stories). Documentation Discipline: A fanatic for keeping documentation current and useful. jd_info.title: Senior Engineer - Front End
jd_info.description: Mô Tả Công Việc Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.Who we’re looking forBased in Vietnam out of our centrally located Ho Chi Minh City office, we’re looking for an experienced Front End Engineer who knows code, and enjoys creating engaging experiences that people love to use.At what3words, we're proud of our tech stack. We have built a massively scalable, microservices-based architecture, based around Kubernetes on AWS. You'll be exposed to technologies such as ReactJS, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS Lambdas, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Athena, BigQuery, Java, Scala, C++, and Swift.This is a great opportunity to join a collaborative, ambitious and Agile team, at one of the most exciting times in this company's life. Xem toàn bộ Mô Tả Công Việc Yêu Cầu Công Việc This role will focus primarily on the development of our map site, account management system, and other websites to support and showcase what3words’ offerings. You will have good experience of building sleek user interfaces on top of RESTful web APIs, using React, JavaScript, CSS. You will be able to work independently, self-motivate, collaborate well with others and keep calm under pressure. What we expect:Strong experience with ES6, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS.Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English.A passion for software engineering and continuous learning.Solid track record of building responsive sites for desktop, tablet and mobile. Bonus points for:Knowledge of Next.js, Google Maps or Leaflet, GIS systems, AWS, Kubernetes, or similar systems.Experience of Agile working environments.The role is based in our centrally located HCMC office. jd_info.title: Staff Engineer - Backend
jd_info.description: Mô Tả Công Việc Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2025. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.Who we’re looking forWe’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer who enjoys solving problems and designing, building and scaling robust services and solutions. You’ll be working to deliver our product roadmap, choosing technologies, evaluating tradeoffs, and seeing your work through all the way to production.At what3words, we’re proud of our tech stack. jd_info.description: Mô Tả Công Việc The MissionWe are seeking a Quality Architect who thrives at the intersection of Marketing Automation (HubSpot), API Orchestration (n8n), and Enterprise Integrations. You are not just a tester; you are the guardian of our data integrity and the bridge between business logic and technical execution.You will be responsible for the End-to-End (E2E) assurance of our complex integration ecosystem. You understand that a "bug" isn't just a broken button—it's a race condition in a workflow, a malformed JSON payload, or a missed requirement in a business process. Crucially, you are an AI-Native Professional. You leverage Artificial Intelligence daily to accelerate test creation, maintain living documentation, and act as a force multiplier for your analysis.Core Responsibilities1. End-to-End Integration Testing (50%)Orchestration Assurance: Design and execute automated test strategies for n8n workflows. Implement "headless" testing using webhooks and API mocks to validate logic without polluting production data. HubSpot Logic Validation: Automate the testing of complex HubSpot workflows, validating enrollment triggers, branching logic, and property mutations. Develop strategies to handle asynchronous race conditions and delays. Advanced API Integrity: Manage deep API testing for external integrations. Validate authentication handling (OAuth/Tokens), schema compliance, and implement data integrity checks (hashing) to ensure zero data loss during transit. 2. AI-Augmented Daily Workflows (25%)AI-Driven Productivity: Utilize LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and AI agents to generate test cases, write boilerplate code, and synthesize realistic test data (e.g., synthetic customer records). Self-Healing Automation: Implement and maintain mabl (or similar AI-native tools) for UI and API testing, leveraging auto-healing capabilities to minimize maintenance on our website and application tests. Exploratory Testing: Conduct AI-guided manual exploratory testing on our websites. Use AI agents to generate "Test Charters" based on changelogs to focus your manual efforts on high-risk areas. 3. Hybrid Business Analysis & Documentation (15%)Shift-Left Analysis: Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements. Use your QA mindset to interrogate business needs, identifying ambiguity and edge cases before development begins. Living Documentation: Champion a "Docs-as-Code" culture. Ensure that documentation for workflows and integrations is kept up-to-date automatically using AI tools and rigorous naming conventions. You define the "Single Source of Truth". 4. Tooling & Infrastructure (10%)Maintain the CI/CD pipeline for n8n workflows (exporting workflows as JSON, validating via CLI). Manage test environments and data mocking strategies for API endpoints and HubSpot. Xem toàn bộ Mô Tả Công Việc Yêu Cầu Công Việc Integration Fluency: 3+ years testing complex integrations involving REST/GraphQL APIs. You know the difference between a 401 and a 403 and how to debug a webhook failure.The AI Edge: Demonstrated ability to apply AI to daily QA tasks. You can show us how you prompt an LLM to generate a comprehensive test suite or analyze a log file.HubSpot & n8n Expertise: Deep understanding of workflow mechanics, CRM properties, and low-code orchestration logic.API Protocol Mastery: Familiarity with complex authentication flows, rate limiting, and strict data schemas.Hybrid Agility: Comfortable switching between a "Technical Tester" hat (debugging API headers) and a "Business Analyst" hat (defining user stories). Documentation Discipline: A fanatic for keeping documentation current and useful.
